name: frontier-founder-smb
description: Frontier Founder SMB (FFSMB) — pre-built small-business workflows (cash flow, month-end close, invoice chasing, weekly briefs, CRM upkeep, customer pulse, contract review, hiring, growth campaigns) on Stripe, QuickBooks, Clarify AI CRM, DocuSign, Gmail/Google, and claude.ai/design. You approve every step that touches money or customers. A MoxyWolf-owned public fork of Anthropic's Small Business plugin, re-homed onto a modern indie-founder stack.
